items.question: How long does it take to design and develop a website?
items.answer: The timeline depends on the size and complexity of the project. A standard business website with our web design company in Kochi usually takes 3-4 weeks, while larger or custom projects may take longer. We'll give you a clear timeline upfront based on your specific requirements.

items.question: Will the website design be custom or template based?
items.answer: We offer both options based on your requirements. Custom designs are created specifically for your brand by our web design agency in Kerala, while template-based solutions provide a faster, more cost-effective approach. We'll help you choose the best option based on your needs and budget.

items.question: What post-launch support and maintenance services do you offer?
items.answer: Our web development support doesn't end at launch. We offer continuous post-launch maintenance, including performance optimization, bug fixes, and security monitoring. As your dedicated website development company in Kochi, we ensure your website remains fast, secure, and up to date with evolving business needs.

items.question: Do you provide SEO with web design?
items.answer: Yes, every website we build follows SEO best practices from the start, helping your business rank and get found by customers searching for your services across Kerala and beyond.

items.question: How will the website help my business grow?
items.answer: We design and develop websites focused on generating leads, improving user experience, and supporting your overall business growth — built to work for your business around the clock, not just during business hours.

items.question: Which platforms and technologies does Inter Smart use for web development?
items.answer: Inter Smart works with PHP, Python, Node, React, Angular, Next.js, and Yii Framework, along with cloud platforms like Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure. The choice of technology depends on your specific requirements, objectives, and features.

items.question: How efficient and experienced are your web app developers?
items.answer: With 15+ years of experience and a team of 130+ skilled professionals, our developers in Kochi follow industry best practices to deliver reliable, scalable, and high-performance websites and web applications tailored to your business needs.

items.question: Can you develop websites for startups, SMEs, and large enterprises?
items.answer: Absolutely. As a leading website development company in Kerala, we build scalable websites for startups, SMEs, and large enterprises alike, ensuring flexibility for future growth — whether you need a simple business website or a complex enterprise platform.
